_comment: Threshold requirements, Wyoming 2027 Affordable Housing Allocation Plan. The Housing Needs minimum score (p.37), the non-point evaluation factors (p.38), and a selection of the 34 numbered Submission Requirements (pp.30-36) that set substantive tests rather than forms. Not extracted: the remaining submission items (forms, fees, narratives, plans), the HOME and NHTF program chapters (pp.10-27), and the post-award Program Requirements (pp.57-65).

criteria.heading: Minimum 100 points in Housing Needs Characteristics
criteria.quote: A minimum score of 100 points must be met in the Housing Needs
criteria.note: 100 of 158 (63%) in one category, before anything else is scored. Unusual in the corpus: the floor applies to a category, not the total.

criteria.heading: Non-point based evaluation criteria
criteria.quote: No point values will be assigned but may impact the application positively or negatively.
criteria.note: Unmitigable environmental issues, developer experience and financial capacity, feasibility, returned credits, foreclosures, consecutive 'At-Risk' team scoring and references from other agencies. Discretionary review factors rather than pass/fail thresholds; recorded here because they carry no points.
